findings.title: The diagnostics sheet note that round 21 rewrote still gives a 5.25 V camera-supply example and labels its 19.9 V worst case as a 'TVS clamp, failed regulator' case on CAM_5V

evidence.file: m3_design/assembly_review/diagnostics.kicad_sch (generated by m3_design/r10_sch.py R21_SHEET_NOTES), note: 'CAM_5V_SENSE = CAM_5V x 1k/11k -> PB1 (pin 35, ADC12_INP5, TT_u 4.0 V max). 5.25 V reads 0.477 V; even 19.9 V (TVS clamp, failed regulator) reads 1.81 V. Lets a battery-powered self-test check the camera supply (U400 buck, U402 switch) ...'
evidence.checked_correct: PB1 is pin 35, TT_u, with ADC12_INP5 (DS12110 Rev 8 Table 9 p. 70). TT pins allow 4.0 V (Table 119 p. 212). R104 10k / R105 1k gives a 1/11 ratio. U400 is the AP63201 buck feeding PORT_5V3, and U402 is the TPS2553 feeding CAM_5V. U400's EN and IN are on RAW_PROTECTED, so PORT_5V3 and CAM_5V are off on USB-only power. The arithmetic is correct.
evidence.stale: R10's camera supply is PORT_5V3 through U402, nominal 5.456 V (docs/M3_R10.md lines 327, 429 and 648; AGENTS camera row), which reads 0.496 V, not the note's 5.25 V / 0.477 V. The 19.9 V figure is the clamp of D8 (SMBJ12CA, VC 19.9 V at 30.2 A, Littelfuse SMBJ datasheet row SMBJ12CA). D8 sits on BAT_IN, ahead of U9's OVLO (9.77 V). Nothing on the CAM_5V net is a TVS: its members are C431, C91, J9.1, R104.1, U13.1 and U402.6 (fresh netlist). The credible failed-regulator case is U400 passing RAW_PROTECTED: at most about 9.8 V, which reads 0.89 V.

findings.impact: Text only, and the bound it gives is conservative (the reading stays under 4.0 V), so there is no hardware risk. But a self-test band copied from this sheet would centre on 0.477 V instead of the 0.488–0.504 V that the 5.367–5.546 V PORT_5V3 band gives, and the note sends the reader to a TVS that is not on this net.
findings.concrete_fix: In r10_sch.py R21_SHEET_NOTES (diagnostics), replace the second line with: 'Nominal 5.456 V (PORT_5V3 via U402) reads 0.496 V; a failed U400 passes RAW_PROTECTED (U9 OVLO 9.77 V) and reads <= 0.89 V; even D8's 19.9 V clamp would read 1.81 V.' Regenerate the sheet. The netlist and board are unchanged.

fix_verification.claim: The round 21 pass changed no MCU pad net
fix_verification.measurement: pcbnew dump of all 701 pad entries on 0dc84776 (git show accfff4) and on 5516eeec. Pad-net differences: 0. Moved parts: R81 and C87 only. U1: 100/100 pads identical in net, position and zone connection. Track and via diff by net: BAT_ENABLE (15 items), GND (4: R81/C87 stubs and vias (16.639,63.939) / (20.706,65.619) removed), 3V3 (1: the new U2.1 run). No U1 signal net touched.

fix_verification.claim: Inner-layer PTH pad hole clearance rule; the In2 power fills stay one piece
fix_verification.measurement: The In2 3V3 fill (U1's VDD plane) is one outline on 5516eeec. U1 is an SMD part and none of its pins are on the changed J1 / J400 / J3 strips. DRC (10.0.7, all severities, schematic parity) gives 0 / 0 / 0 on a project copy.

fix_verification.claim: U2.1 (AP63203 FB, the 3V3 sense that sets the MCU supply) has a second path
fix_verification.measurement: U2 is on the bottom; pad 1 is centred at (24.05,68.6). Path 1: B.Cu 0.4 mm (24.05,68.6) -> via (23.2,68.6). Path 2: B.Cu 0.4 mm (24.05,68.95) -> via (23.0,70.0), which also takes R89's F.Cu 0.3 mm stub. Both vias lie inside the one-piece In2 3V3 fill (Contains = True). An open FB on a fixed-output AP63203 would let 3V3 rise (Inference), so this protects U1, U4 and U5.

fix_verification.claim: U4 is the fitted ISM6HG256X, the LSM6DSV320X is the alternate; FS_XL_HG 001 / 010 shared; pins 10 / 11 open with pull-ups
fix_verification.measurement: DS15034 Rev 1 p1: low-g ±2–16 g, high-g ±32/64/128/256 g, gyro to ±4000 dps. Table 150 p93: 000 ±32, 001 ±64, 010 ±128, 100 ±256, 011 reserved. DS14623 Rev 1 Table 150 p93: 000 ±32, 001 ±64, 010 ±128, 011 ±256, 100 ±320. So 001 / 010 mean the same on both parts, and 011 / 100 differ. DS15034 Table 25 pp51-52: pins 10 / 11 'Default: input with pull-up'; DS14623 the same in mode 1. fc(SPC) 10 MHz on both. Board: U4.9 / .10 / .11 unconnected, U4.2 / .3 on GND (mode 1 'connect to VDDIO or GND').

fix_verification.claim: Battery-powered camera self-test (U400 buck, U402 switch); PORT_5V3 and CAM_5V off on USB-only power

fix_verification.claim: No lead fuse (OQ-6); BAT_IN members; U9 latches; Q120 drain on BAT_IN; R134 limits the fire path
fix_verification.measurement: BAT_IN members: C80, C88 (BAT_IN to GND), C89 / C95 (to BAT_DAMP), C96, D8 SMBJ12CA, J1.1, Q120.5-9, R167, R80, R82, TP80 and U9.5. TPS259470L is the latch-off variant (SLVSFC9C Device Comparison table, p3). R134 joins RAW_ACT and PYRO1_IGN. The listed parts are right. The high-value resistors on BAT_IN (R80, R82, R167) and TP80 are left out of the list, which does not mislead.

fix_verification.claim: BAT_ENABLE re-route and the R81 / C87 move leave MCU nets alone
fix_verification.measurement: I compared every foreign-net approach under 1 mm (tracks, pads, vias, fills, all four layers) for ACT_EN_MCU, ACT_EN, PYRO1_GATE_N, PYRO1_GATE, BAT_FAULT_N (PA5), LOGIC_SOURCE_ST (PA4), 3V3A and IMU_INT1 on both boards: identical. The new B.Cu BAT_ENABLE pieces are at least 3.247 mm from ACT_EN and 1.706 mm from ACT_EN_MCU. The new 3V3 run is at least 4.099 mm from RAW_ACT.

fix_verification.claim: GPS USART3 PD8 / PD9, radio UART5 PB13 / PB12, AUX USART6 PC6 / PC7, camera UART7 PE8 / PE7
fix_verification.measurement: DS12110 Rev 8: PD8 / PD9 AF7 USART3_TX / RX (Table 13 p94); PB12 / PB13 AF14 UART5_RX / TX (Table 11 p91); PC6 / PC7 AF7 USART6_TX / RX (Table 12 p92); PE7 / PE8 AF7 UART7_RX / TX (Table 14 p95). Each was read by column offset under the AF header. Board: R441 / R451 / R471 TX, R440 / R450 / R470 RX, each 1k 1 % (C21190), to J410 / J420 / J440 pin 3 (TXO) / pin 4 (RXI) through D410/411, D420/421 and D440/441. The camera goes through U12 (TXU0202).

fix_verification.claim: Q122 has R122 1k series, R123 2k pull-down, C123 10 nF gate-source
fix_verification.measurement: Netlist: ACT_EN_MCU = U1.16 and R122.1; ACT_EN = R122.2, R123.1, C123.1 and Q122.1 (gate); R123.2 / C123.2 / Q122.2 = GND. AO3400A VGS(th) is 0.65–1.45 V. PC1 high gives 2.2 V at the gate. Against a 30 kOhm internal pull-up the gate sits at ≤0.218 V (3.6 V). PE4 / Q124: R126 220R series, R127 1k at the pin, R128 10k and C126 220 nF gate-source, AON7524 VGS(th) min 0.4 V; the pull-up case gives 0.104 V. AGENTS §2.4 is met for both.

fix_verification.claim: IMU_INT1 on PE1 with the ISM6HG256X
fix_verification.measurement: IMU_INT1 joins only U1.98 (PE1, FT_h, EXTI1) and U4.4. DS15034 Table 25: INT1 'Default: output forced to ground'. IF_CFG (p60): H_LACTIVE = 0 (active high), PP_OD = 0 (push-pull). With PE1's internal pull-down this is consistent. U4 is at B(17,45.9), 180°, so the lever arm is x = -6.0 mm.

fix_verification.claim: VREF+ is tied to VDDA on 3V3A; VREFBUF_CSR reset ENVR = 0, HIZ = 1; never write it
fix_verification.measurement: U1.20 and U1.21 are both on 3V3A (R164 2.2R from 3V3). ST's CMSIS SVD STM32H743x (cmsis-svd mirror) gives VREFBUF CSR resetValue 0x00000002 (ENVR bit 0 = 0, HIZ bit 1 = 1), and the HIZ field refers to 'Table196: VREF buffer modes'. ST LL driver stm32h7xx_ll_system.h: DisableHIZ = 'VREF+ pin is internally connected to the voltage reference buffer output'. The mode-table row ENVR = 0 / HIZ = 0 = pull-down to VSSA is still second-hand: RM0433 and AN5690 downloads failed again.
fix_verification.verdict: confirmed (reset value now from ST SVD; mode table still Inference as recorded)

rejected_or_closed_candidates: Board frame handedness / IMU map (+X_imu = -x, +Y_imu = -y, +Z_imu = -z looks improper). Closed: the documented board frame is left-handed because KiCad y points down (M3_R10 line 551, R7-MEC-07), and the roll sign -gyro_Y is defined physically about the forward axis.

Port mapped but its device unplugged: RX floats with pulls disabled. Closed: M3_R10 Firmware already requires bounded UART DMA / IDLE / framing-error handling. Pulls are off by design (Table 122 note 3).

U400 / U401 dropout or thermal stop while PA4 is low leaves port TX idle-high into an unpowered module. Bounded at about 2.7 mA through the 1 k; it is the recorded no-powered-off-isolation residual, so no new hazard.

Battery and USB both present: does PA4 park the port UARTs although the ports are powered? No. U11 PR1 = CP2 = GND selects VCOMP mode (TPS2121 Table 9-3 p18), so a 6–8.4 V pack beats 5 V USB, ST is low and the ports stay enabled. Only a pack near 5 V hands over to USB, which parks TX (fail-safe).

Back-feed into an unpowered MCU from always-on ports. Closed: FT VIN max is Min(VDD, VDDA, VDD33USB, VBAT) + 4.0 V, so 4.0 V at VDD = 0, and positive injection is not possible (DS12110 Rev 8 Table 119 p212, Table 120 note 3 p213). A port TX at ≤ 3.6 V through 1 k is inside that. PA4 / PA5 (TT_a, injection 0/0) see only 3V3-referred pull-ups.

Sentinels: U1.2 (PE3) and U1.4 (PE5) are no-net, 0.200 mm pad gaps to U1.3 (package pitch), with no copper or fill on any of the 31 no-net U1 pads. PE6 / PC4 are no-net too. This matches obligation 7 and the R10_VALIDATION residual row.
PE4 gate inrush (about 18.3 mA peak through R126 into C126, plus R127): recorded at 18.7 mA against 20 mA (Table 120 IIO), so not refiled.

Battery_entry note says R134 limits 'the RAW_ACT fire path'. RAW_ACT copper from Q121 to R134.2 (R132, TP120) is unlimited while PC1 is high. The note is accurate as worded, and REQUIREMENTS line 101 carries the full statement, so not filed.
ACT_EN_MCU to BUZZ_OUT 0.520 mm, ACT_EN to BAT_ENABLE 0.330 mm, ACT_EN_MCU to RAW_PROTECTED 0.827 mm: unchanged since D-R18-03 and recorded.
